The '''Mission to Mustafar''' was a mission carried out by [[Rianna Saren]]. After she learned that a new drug was used
on Mustafar to increase the slave production of [[Mirkanite/Legends|mirkanite]], a material used in construction of turbolasers, she went there to stop the production. She also hoped to find [[Zarien Kheev]], a slaver who cut off her lekku.

==Mission==
{{Quote|Let's blow this place up...|[[Rianna Saren]]|<ref name="Alliance" />}}
Rianna and Zeeo infiltrated the Imperial [[Mirkanite Mining Facility/Legends|Mirkanite Mining Facility]] and soon discovered that the mirkanite was delivered to [[Despayre]] and that [[Zarien Kheev]] wasn't on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. They continued their mission and soon found a group of [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] slaves who managed to escape. One of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] gave them access codes to the main computer. Using those codes [[Z-58-0|Zeeo]] put the drill on overdrive. They also saw a hologram of Kheev hiring [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] to track down [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] intruders. However, Zeeo discovered that Zarien had already departed for [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Rianna decided that her time with the Rebellion was over and followed Kheev there.
{{Quote|We'll finish this mission, we'll get our money, and then we're going to Tatooine. No more Alliance, Zeeo. We've done all we can for them. It'll be just you and me.|[[Rianna Saren]] before the end of the mission|<ref name="Alliance" />}}
